title: Mangyan artisans urge protection of crafts, cultural heritage

blocks.text: CALAPAN CITY, Oriental Mindoro — Mangyan artisans and educators called for stronger protection of their indigenous crafts, traditional knowledge, and cultural identity, stressing that preserving their heritage also means protecting ancestral lands and sustaining community livelihoods. They made the call during the fourth Agkatipon Pagkaruwan Mangyan: Indigenous Peoples’ Summit 2026 held at the Divine Word College of Calapan (DWCC) gymnasium on Oct. 22, which gathered about 1,500 participants to celebrate National Indigenous Peoples Month. The summit gave indigenous representatives a platform to share their communities’ identities, cultures, traditions, languages, indigenous knowledge systems, and beliefs.
